notes.title: FIRST CONTENT UPDATE! NEW PRODUCTS AND LICENSES!
notes.notes:
Hello shopmen and shopwomen,

We have our first content update a few days into Early Access,
Each shop level is packed with new products in all categories such as Freezer, Fridge, Shelf and Vegetables:
[list]
[*] Beverages
[*] Dairy
[*] Cleaning Product
[*] Pasta
[*] Sauce
[*] Coffee
[*] and of course toilet paper! 
[*] and many more...
[/list]

[b]Staff Dialog Change[/b]
A Slight dialog change when you tell the staff to restock shelves.
They offer the option to either fill any empty shelves or just the labelled ones.

[h2]Report Bugs, Suggestion and Questions:[/h2]
[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3396090/discussions/]DISCUSSION[/url][/h1]
[h1][url=https://discord.gg/FzEa7sv3KA]DISCORD[/url][/h1]

notes.title: (0.1.1.1) Easter Event - Patch Note
notes.notes:
[h2]Thanks everyone for reporting these issues[/h2] 
Any reported bugs will be addressed in a timely manner, please do report bugs.

[b][NEW] [/b] Customer will be on a lookout for Easter eggs to buy, for duration of the event.

[h3]Notable Fixes:[/h3]

[b][FIXED] [/b] After loading a save, rejecting or accepting offers/contracts
[b][FIXED] [/b] sometimes Customer getting stuck by Fridge or Freezer.
[b][FIXED] [/b] Restockers standing still after sometimes and not doing their jobs.
[b][FIXED] [/b] Restockers only put 3 cereals on the shelves and dispose the reset, [i]secretly[/i].
[b][FIXED] [/b] Number of products in the box shown incorrectly for some items in the Product Market app.

[b][CHANGE] [/b]In multiplayer, anyone should be able to buy Wall Expansions.

notes.title: (0.1.1.0) First Content Update - Patch Note
notes.notes:
Big Content update, these content was suggested by the community.
[h3]There will be a Post containing more info about this update soo,[/h3]

[b][NEW] [MAJOR] [/b]A large variety of products has been added, with more license for every level and more

[h1]Thanks everyone for reporting these issues[/h1] 
They all will be addressed in a timely manner.

[b][CHANGE] [/b]Fruit should now be stocked on a Vegetable shelf, instead of fridge shelf. if you already have fruits from previously, then you should stock them in the fridge.


[b][FIXED] [/b]Lottery Ticket Winnings isn't shown correctly at the end of the day report.
[b][FIXED] [/b]Fired staff can't be recruited again from the recruit app.

[b][FIXED] [/b]After loading a save, shelves incorrectly shown 2 as the total number of products in it
